bootstrap.resampling_unit: task family, retaining all of its twin pairs

method: Offline counts of turns that break an explicit prompt rule, read from saved actions and observation text with comet.instruction_errors; no model, tool or evaluator was run.

prompt_layout.method: Tokenizer only, pinned Qwen3.5-9B chat template with thinking disabled; first-turn lengths are the first trigger check of saved seed-17 attempts.

rule_token_spans.rule: one fenced code block per turn
apis already exists; never import; no requests or URLs
read one API's documentation before calling it
do not guess names or arguments
obtain credentials; password record by app name
username is email or phone; app name is never the username
